The proof was correct over the statistic's range and useless over the space of EXPLANATIONS, because the m=35 artifact fires in the null too. The producer reports the verdicts verbatim, did NOT re-score, and marked the real/null contrast POST HOC in results.json.

Three further defects in its own design were caught by synthetic checks BEFORE any measurement and fixed (changelog v1->v3): offdiag(R_ctr) forced to -1/(K-1) with zero comparator spread; scoring against asymptotic rather than finite-sample references, which manufactured a 4 sigma departure out of iid data; var_cv invariant under CAL-PERM.

The producer's own read: PARTLY FORCED, PARTLY NOT, and it says exactly which part. The closed form predicts the whole correlation structure with NO scoring (6.052 against 6.012 measured; 17.480 against 17.419), so it is a geometric functional of (X,Y) -- the fifth in this campaign. But UNLIKE batches 1-4 it is not fixed regardless of what is measured: on the SAME database and the SAME error draws it returns the law's value (0.999-1.011) for uniform candidates and 0.45 for secret-distribution ones. Whether it is nonetheless forced for EVERY valid dual family is NOT SETTLED here; the producer names the test -- build a family with Y columns S-orthogonalised and re-measure -- and notes the closed form makes it free.
